claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the great value and low price per pair, especially for dramatic lashes.
Many customers love the variety of multiple different styles included in one pack.
The cute packaging is a commonly mentioned positive.
Several reviewers find the lashes too long, heavy, or overly dramatic for their taste.
A few reviewers report quality or consistency problems, such as pairs not matching or not resembling the pictures.
